title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 OCT)
summary: A curated list of user-submitted feature requests and improvement ideas for Dynamics 365 Business Central spanning October 2026, covering areas like Copilot agents, data migrations, financial management, localization, inventory, manufacturing, and platform administration.
key_points: Collection of 80+ feature ideas submitted by the community across multiple Business Central modules
Requests address Copilot cross-company access, dark mode, improved e-invoicing support, and workflow enhancements
Ideas span development improvements, localization requirements for various countries, and tenant administration features
Suggestions include inventory management features like consignment inventory and costing for service items
Covers platform-level improvements such as API throughput, job queue entry recovery, and security group notifications

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a community-driven collection of improvement suggestions for evaluating Business Central enhancements
